FOUNDER, DREAMER

Favio M. Giorgio Data

Reading and a passion for history led me to travel through Latin America and the Caribbean, the Patria Grande. There my social and ideological awareness grew: I coordinated the 'Che Guevara Route in Bolivia' project alongside peasants and indigenous communities. I resumed my studies in Business Administration and, after years of preparation, designed the dream of cycling around the world. The planned journey ended in New Zealand. But my road continued...

MANIFESTO

How SportDharma Ecosystem was born

When the planned journey ended in New Zealand, questions arose about impermanence and life's purpose. Seeking answers, I discovered the Japanese Ikigai: the intersection of passion, mission and vocation. There SportDharma Ecosystem was born: free and sovereign infrastructure for those who practice sports, live in isolated areas without connectivity, and emergency teams.

THE 9 PILLARS

Principles that define us

Sovereign Software, Transparent, Modular, Permanent Education, Solidarity, Ecological, Inclusive, Aligned Sustainability and Resilient.

MOBILE APP

Your offline companion on the road

Topographic maps, GPS tracking and travel diary. Works 100% without internet, keeping your data under your total control.

WEBSITE

Human-curated content

News, technical guides and organized resources. Installable as PWA, multi-language and fully functional offline.

MASF ENGINE

Human curation, not algorithmic

Multi-Agent Swarm Architecture. Humans curate, AI assists. No opaque algorithms or hidden biases.

CURRENT STATUS

Project in active development

Base infrastructure construction phase. Preparing the application to the Proton Foundation Community Project with maximum quality and security.

NEWS AND INFORMATION

Human curation, 6 daily publications

Fresh, verified and relevant content for the outdoor community, free from commercial biases and opaque algorithms.

THE ECOSYSTEM

Tools we use

Astro, Tailwind CSS, Vite PWA, and multi-agent architectures. Modern, lightweight and 100% open source stack.

SUPPORT THE PROJECT

Free software needs support

Your contribution keeps the infrastructure alive, without advertising or data selling. Grants and direct donations.
